wrong.why: Reaiah is the son of the Shobal who is a son of Judah in verse 1, which is shobal-3; shobal-2 is the son of Hur in 1CH 2:50.
Verse 1 makes the Shobal here a son of Judah, which is shobal-3, not shobal-2 the son of Hur.
The Shobal who begat Reaiah is the son of Judah (shobal-3), not shobal-2 the son of Hur.
The sons of Ishi who led the five hundred are the Simeonite Ishi, not the Ishi of verse 20.
Pelatiah is one of the sons of Ishi in verse 42, which is the Simeonite Ishi, not the Ishi of verse 20.
Rephaiah is one of the sons of Ishi in verse 42, which is the Simeonite Ishi, not the Ishi of verse 20.
Uzziel is one of the sons of Ishi in verse 42, which is the Simeonite Ishi, not the Ishi of verse 20.
The words son of Amaziah in verse 34 attach to Joshah alone, and Meshobab is not said to descend from Amaziah.
The verse names Naham only as father of Keilah; Eshtemoa is listed among the sons of Hodiah's wife with no father given.

missing.why: The chapter lists Hezron among the sons of Judah, and no row joins him to Judah, as it does Carmi, Hur and Shobal.

note: Owner rows that look wrong: meonothai son-of othniel (106560), which 4:13 does not state, and hodiah brother-in-law-of naham (106648), which fits the Hebrew but not the KJV's 'the sister of Naham'. Carmi and Hur are only descendant-of Judah, and the Ezer rows on ezer-6 duplicate ezer-2.
